It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities.
About the team
Mastercard’s Advisors & Consulting Services (A&CS) team helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.
What you’ll do
As an Associate Consultant Intern, you will collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. You will immediately create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more.
You will:
Work in small teams to support strategic consulting projects across industries
Collaborate with colleagues across different areas of the organization and gain exposure to business development, account management, and product management
Analyze data, identify trends, and help translate insights into recommendations
Create clear and compelling presentations for internal teams and clients
Support problem solving by structuring challenges and exploring solutions
Build an understanding of how consulting engagements are delivered end to end
Participate in volunteer and team building experiences
Gain exposure to our leadership team through networking sessions and speaker series
Begin to build relationships with clients to understand their business needs, seek strategic solutions and guide impactful decisions
Grow by receiving hands-on mentorship from an experienced management team
Specialization Tracks
We are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. We are recruiting five specialization tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.
Business Experimentation
Leverage Mastercard's industry-leading predictive analytics platform, Test & Learn®, and SQL to run data-backed business experiments for our clients. Consultants focus on data science-based solutions to provide insights on various business initiatives, including product launches, marketing campaigns, customer loyalty, and pricing across various industries that touch many Fortune 500 companies. Partner directly with clients to share findings and help determine which ideas are effective, as well as where, when, and how to implement them.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:
Where should a retailer open new stores to maximize profitability and minimize the cannibalization of nearby omnichannel sales?
What bonus should be provided to someone opening a credit card account to entice them to use the card regularly?
Strategy & Transformation
Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer
How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market?
How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial, and strategic goals?
Performance Analytics
Use quantitative and qualitative skills and enterprise applications (e.g., Business Intelligence Platforms, SQL, Python, and more) to drive data-led consulting solutions for customers. Weave together vast amounts of Mastercard, client & 3rd party data assets to investigate trends, build propensity models, develop data visualizations, and synthesize millions of data points into a cohesive story. Engage with client stakeholders through virtual and in-person meetings, leveraging insights to inform strategic recommendations.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:
How does a financial institution fraud/authorization metrics fare against competitors, and what are strategies that can help it be best-in-class?
How is a technology customer’s market share changing over time, and are there any segments where the client is relatively under penetrated?
Marketing
Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard.
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:
How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications?
How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer?
How can a large financial institution best execute a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more?
Deploy
Help clients implement, launch, and scale Mastercard products, platforms, and business transformation initiatives. Combine program management, stakeholder engagement, and implementation expertise to guide complex initiatives from strategy into execution.
Work closely with client and Mastercard teams, coordinate cross-functional efforts, manage risks and dependencies, and drive adoption to ensure clients realize value from their investments.
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:
How can a financial institution successfully implement and launch a new payments, fraud, or digital banking solution while minimizing disruption to customers and internal teams?
What governance structure, implementation roadmap, and stakeholder engagement plan will best position a client to deliver a large-scale transformation on time and within scope?
How can a client accelerate adoption and maximize the value of a newly deployed platform, product, or technology investment across its organization?
What we’re looking for
Undergraduate or accelerated master’s degree with an expected graduation date between Dec 2027-July 2028
We recruit for and value the following core competencies:
Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities.
Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical, and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks)
.Business Interest:
Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions.
Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities.
Teamwork: Willingness to work within small teams to produce outstanding deliverables, with a will to win attitude.
Integrity: Outstanding record of academic achievement. Commitment to Mastercard's values of honesty and integrity with a willingness to embrace and learn from mistakes.
Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity.
Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
As an intern, you'll benefit from
Mentorship and coaching from experienced professionals and leaders
Networking opportunities with fellow interns, employees, and senior leaders
Professional development experiences focused on career growth and skill-building
Exposure to innovative technologies and global business challenges
Volunteer, community engagement, and team-building activities
Many of our interns continue building their careers with Mastercard through full-time opportunities, early career programs, or future internships
[If applicable] Please submit your transcript with your application.

https://www.theforage.com/simulations/mastercard/advisors-client-services-xvlw

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

postings.title: Intern
postings.description:
Intern
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
Who We Are:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
Job Description:
We offer university students the opportunity to join a leading IT company and gain invaluable experience through our Internship Program (9 months) . Hewlett Packard Enterprise offers you a highly dynamic, fast-paced, professional working environment and the chance to develop the skills you have gained at university in a real business environment. During your internship you will not only apply these skills in the IT industry, but also acquire a range of abilities to contribute to the business whilst working alongside industry professionals. Throughout the program, you'll have regular training and one-to-one meetings with your manager. Working together, you'll set goals and plot your development. And with our open-plan offices and friendly working culture, you'll have the chance to learn from senior managers who can help you in your future career.
Start Date : January 2027
Location : Wroclaw, Poland
Mandatory Requirements: Enrolled at a University for the duration of the internship, part time (30 hours) availability for 9 months, Polish & English on an advanced professional level is essential for this role
What you'll do
· Support the development of AI-powered solutions using Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio.
· Assist in building and maintaining Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Automate, Power Apps, and Power BI.
· Support Robotic Process Automation (RPA) initiatives through process mapping, testing, and documentation activities.
· Identify opportunities to automate and improve Finance business processes.
· Participate in innovation initiatives, proof-of-concepts, and pilot projects.
· Analyze business requirements and propose technology-driven improvements.
· Prepare technical documentation, user guides, and training materials.

Internship – Systems Engineer (Networking)
This internship is designed for recent graduates who want to start a career in technical presales on enterprise networking.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next, and we value diverse backgrounds. If you are looking to start and grow your career, our culture will embrace you.
About the Internship
HPE Networking is redefining the intelligent edge: campus, branch, data center, mobility and IoT networks that combine connectivity, security and AI-driven operations. We help some of the largest organizations in Italy modernize their networks for a digital future.
As an Intern Systems Engineer you will join the Italian presales team and learn how technology turns into customer solutions. You will work side by side with experienced Systems Engineers, with a dedicated mentor and a structured training plan, gaining real exposure to customers, partners and the full sales cycle.

Learn the HPE Networking portfolio (wired and wireless LAN, SD-WAN, SASE, network access control, cloud and AI-driven management) through structured training and hands-on labs
Support Systems Engineers in preparing and delivering presentations and product demonstrations to customers and partners
Take part in customer meetings, workshops and proof-of-concepts, helping with lab setup, configuration and test documentation
Contribute to technical documentation: solution designs, bills of materials, answers to technical requirements in tenders
Participate in internal enablement sessions and work toward your first vendor certifications

Recent graduate in Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related field
Basic knowledge of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, OSI model, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi
Basic understanding of network security and cloud concepts
Strong curiosity for technology and willingness to learn fast
Good communication skills and interest in customer-facing roles
Team player with a positive, proactive attitude
Good knowledge of English, spoken and written; fluent Italian

Entry-level certifications (e.g. CCNA, HPE/Aruba ACA, Juniper JNCIA) or related university courses
Thesis, projects or lab experience on networking, security, cloud or automation

A structured internship with a dedicated mentor and a training path on the HPE Networking portfolio
Real exposure to enterprise customers, partners and projects
Access to labs, demo equipment and certification programs
Internship allowance and hybrid work model
A diverse and dynamic environment where interns are actively considered for future junior Systems Engineer positions
Join us and make your mark!

Job Description:
Location: Manchester
Start Date: 1 July 2027
Duration: 13 months
Start your career at the heart of the technology industry
As a Sales Analyst Intern, you’ll join Hewlett Packard Enterprise’s UK & Ireland Commercial Sales organisation and gain first-hand experience of how a global technology company works with customers to solve business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes.
Based in our Manchester office, you’ll work closely with sales professionals and teams across the UK & Ireland, supporting customer strategy, sales opportunities and business performance. This is much more than a traditional support role. You’ll be encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership of projects and develop the commercial skills that can help launch your future career.
From analysing customer accounts and identifying opportunities to supporting live sales engagements, forecasting business performance and shadowing experienced sales professionals, you’ll gain broad exposure to the entire sales environment. You don’t need to arrive as a sales expert. We’re looking for people who are curious, ambitious, proactive and ready to learn.
Your experience at HPE
Your internship will give you exposure to the people, customers and technology shaping the future of business.
You’ll have the opportunity to learn how successful sales teams operate, understand how we build relationships with customers and partners, and see how technology can help organisations tackle some of their biggest challenges.
You’ll also join HPE’s wider Early Careers community, connecting with interns from across the UK & Ireland. Through our structured development programme and quarterly development days, you’ll build your network, develop important professional skills and learn alongside other early-career talent.
You'll be supported throughout your placement by experienced colleagues, a designated mentor and our Early Careers team. You'll also receive a four-week handover from the current intern, helping you build confidence, understand the role and make an impact from the beginning.
What you’ll do
During your placement, you will:
Support sales teams in managing and progressing customer opportunities.
Build your understanding of HPE’s strategy, customers, technology portfolio and sales organisation.
Conduct customer profiling, account mapping and analysis to help sellers identify new opportunities.
Support forecasting, reporting and analysis of sales activity and business performance.
Gain exposure to live sales cycles and shadow experienced sales professionals.
Work alongside sellers on customer and partner initiatives, giving you real-world commercial experience.
Contribute to projects across the wider Commercial Sales organisation, from customer initiatives to partner and corporate hospitality activities.
Participate in team events, sales activities and projects designed to drive business success.
Build relationships across HPE and develop a professional network that extends beyond your immediate team.
Take increasing ownership and responsibility as your confidence and experience grow.
What we’re looking for
We’re looking for students who are motivated by learning, comfortable taking initiative and excited by the opportunity to build a career in the technology industry.
To be eligible, you should:
Be in the second year of a four-year degree that requires, or offers, a third-year industrial placement.
On track for 2:1 or above.
Be eligible to work in the UK and available to start the placement in July 2027 for 13 months.
Have an interest in developing a career in sales, technology, business or commercial operations.
Be proactive, curious and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.
Have strong written and verbal communication skills.
Be organised and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
Be comfortable using Microsoft Office. Experience with Excel and PowerPoint would be beneficial.
Above all, we’re interested in your potential. You don’t need to know everything about enterprise technology or sales before joining us. We’re looking for people who are willing to learn, challenge themselves and make the most of the opportunity.

At HPE, an internship is an opportunity to learn, contribute and build the foundations of your future career .

A competitive salary.
A modern, centrally located Manchester office.
Hands-on experience within a global technology organisation.
Exposure to customers, partners and experienced sales professionals.

Communications & Programmes Intern - Placement Year
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
Who We Are:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
Job Description:
Location: Central London
Start Date: July 2027
You might not know HPE yet. But you’ve probably experienced the impact of our technology.
Ever streamed a film, followed a Formula 1 race, visited a major sporting event or wondered how AI is changing the world? Behind many of these experiences is technology that connects people, processes huge amounts of data and helps organisations do extraordinary things.
Big technology. Bigger opportunities to make a difference.
At HPE, we believe a great workplace is built by its people. Across the UKIMEA, our team members are creating communities, championing inclusion, supporting wellbeing and making a real difference beyond their day jobs.
Our culture isn’t just something we talk about. It’s something our people actively build.
Through our Resource Groups and Site Councils, colleagues lead initiatives that bring people together, celebrate different backgrounds and help everyone feel they belong. Our Day of Service has brought thousands of volunteering hours to charities and local communities, while our commitment to inclusion, wellbeing and development has earned recognition at the CRN Women & Diversity in Channel Awards, including the Health and Wellbeing Recognition Award and Highly Commended Best Place to Work. And you don’t need to be a senior leader to make an impact. Some of our most exciting ideas come from people just starting their careers.
Your placement. Your opportunity to make an impact.
We’re looking for a curious, creative and motivated Programmes Intern to join our UKIMEA (UK, Ireland, Middle East and Africa) Managing Director’s Office in London for a 13-month placement.
This isn’t a role where you’ll spend a year watching from the sidelines.
You’ll work alongside a team that helps shape how we communicate, engage our people and connect with some of the world’s leading organisations. One day you might be helping bring a leadership event to life, the next creating communications that reach colleagues across different countries, supporting an initiative that makes a difference in our communities, or helping develop programmes that connect our senior executives with customers.
You’ll gain exposure to different parts of the business, work with experienced leaders and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to the table.
We don’t expect you to know everything when you arrive. What matters is your curiosity, willingness to learn and enthusiasm to get involved.
If you’re looking for a placement where you can develop your skills, build meaningful relationships and finish the year knowing you’ve made a real contribution, we’d love to hear from you.
What you’ll need:
Potential interns must be in their 2nd year of a four-year degree which requires (or has an option for) 3rd year to be a one year's industrial placement, and are expected to achieve a minimum of a 2:1 grade
Ideally from degree courses focused on communications/business management/graphic design/film production preferred.
You must be eligible to work in the UK and be available to commence the placement at the beginning of July 2027 for 13 months.
Experience or knowledge of video production and/ the use of Adobe software including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects and Premier Pro Ability to use the Microsoft Office package to a high standard (particularly Excel & PowerPoint).
What we’d prefer you bring:
You'll be able to use your own initiative and self-motivation to work independently
You will have good time management and organizational skills while being structured in your approach
You'll be adaptable in handling new and evolving requirements
Show Creativity in approaching projects
Exceptional written, visual and oral communication skills
Accuracy and attention to detail
What you'll do:
End to end production of internal videos
Experience in the use of various Adobe software to create clear and branded communications
Creation of a company magazine, posters, slide decks and newsletters to promote events projects, company strategy and initiatives to a wide audience of employees
An opportunity to develop both professional and technical skills
Exposure to senior leadership and collaboration widely across the organization
Reviewing, editing and creating various communications content
Maintaining fresh and accurate content for key intranet sites
Tracking and overseeing budgets
Coordinating end to end events
Strategic planning for events in place and in development
Using an analytical approach, provide valuable feedback, thoughts and opinions

Job Description:
Location: Manchester, UK / On-site
Role: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
Start Date: 1st July 2027
About the Role
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Sales Development Representative to join our Digital Sales organisation.
As an SDR, your primary mission is simple: create qualified sales pipeline through high-quality outbound prospecting.
You will identify and engage prospective customers, uncover business and technology challenges, develop relationships with key decision-makers and create new opportunities for HPE's Digital Sales teams.
This is not simply a high-volume calling role. We are looking for individuals who are curious about our customers, confident engaging senior stakeholders and capable of turning research, insight and conversations into meaningful commercial opportunities. The role provides an excellent foundation for someone looking to build a career in technology sales and progress into a customer-facing sales position within HPE.
What you’ll need:
Potential interns must be in their 2nd year of a four-year degree which requires (or has an option for) 3rd year to be a one year's industrial placement
On track to achieve 2:1 or above
You must be eligible to work in the UK and be available to commence the placement at the beginning of July 2027 for 13 months.
Keen to develop your skills and interested in building a career in technology sales.
What You'll Do
Generate Qualified Pipeline
Proactively identify and engage new prospects across HPE's target accounts.
Create qualified sales opportunities for the Digital Sales organisation.
Take ownership of pipeline generation targets and consistently work towards achieving them.
Qualify opportunities based on customer need, business impact, stakeholders, timing and potential commercial value.
Work closely with Digital Sales representatives to ensure opportunities are effectively transitioned and progressed.
Execute High-Quality Outbound Prospecting
Conduct consistent outbound activity across telephone, email, LinkedIn and other digital channels.
Develop personalised outreach rather than relying solely on high-volume generic messaging.
Research target organisations, industries and stakeholders ahead of engagement.
Use customer news, strategic priorities, technology trends and market events to create relevant reasons to engage.
Engage customers with curiosity and a consultative mindset.
Identify business challenges, technology priorities and potential areas where HPE can add value.
Build relationships across multiple stakeholders within target organisations.
Develop an understanding of how technology decisions are made within enterprise and commercial customers.
Capture high-quality information that helps the wider account team progress each opportunity.
Partner with Digital Sales
Work closely with Digital Sales Account Managers to understand their territories, priority accounts and pipeline requirements.
Agree target account lists and prospecting strategies with sales representatives.
Collaborate on account plans and whitespace opportunities.
Provide regular insight on prospect engagement, market trends and customer feedback.
Maintain clear ownership and communication throughout the opportunity handover process.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role will be measured primarily by the quality and value of pipeline created, supported by leading activity and conversion indicators.
Key measures could include:
Qualified pipeline created
Number of qualified opportunities generated
Pipeline accepted and progressed by Digital Sales
Outbound customer conversations
New stakeholders engaged
Meetings generated from outbound prospecting
Prospect-to-opportunity conversion
Opportunity progression and conversion
Coverage across priority accounts
Consistency and quality of CRM data
The objective is not simply to generate activity. Successful SDRs create opportunities that convert into real sales pipeline and ultimately revenue.
Skills & Experience
Previous technology sales experience is not essential.
We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate:
Strong verbal and written communication
Confidence communicating by telephone
Excellent interpersonal skills
Commercial awareness and curiosity
Strong organisational and time-management skills
Ability to research organisations and stakeholders
Ability to work towards measurable goals and targets
A willingness to learn about enterprise technology
Resilience and a strong work ethic
A growth mindset and desire to develop a career in sales
What you can expect from us:
A competitive salary
A central Manchester office location
Diverse and dynamic work environment
Work-life balance and support for career development
An amazing life inside the element!

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
Who We Are:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
Job Description:
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly motivated PCB Layout Automation Intern to support automation and tool development efforts within our networking hardware engineering team.
This role is ideal for a student interested in combining hardware design with programming. The intern will gain hands-on experience developing automation tools using Cadence Allegro PCB Designer and the SKILL , while supporting high-speed PCB layout projects for networking platforms such as switches and routers.
You will work closely with senior PCB engineers to improve workflow efficiency, create reusable tools, and help standardize layout processes.
Responsibilities:
Primary Focus: Automation & Tool Development
Assist in developing and testing SKILL-based automation utilities
Modify and enhance existing SKILL scripts for:
Differential pair validation
Length matching reports
Constraint audits
Design rule automation
Create simple custom Allegro forms (GUI elements) using SKILL
Develop reporting tools for layout metrics and quality checks
Document scripting workflows and best practices
Support integration of Allegro automation with external scripts (Python or batch tools)
Secondary Exposure: PCB Layout Support
Assist with basic routing and placement tasks
Run design rule checks (DRC) and analyze results
Support engineering change orders (ECOs)
Observe high-speed routing methodologies for Ethernet, PCIe, and DDR interfaces
Gain exposure to stack-up design and impedance control principles
Education & Experience:
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
Coursework in programming (data structures, scripting, or software fundamentals)
Strong interest in combining software development with hardware design
Analytical mindset and problem-solving ability
Knowledge & Skills:
Exposure to SKILL
Familiarity with Cadence Allegro PCB Designer
Experience with Python, Tcl, or other scripting languages
Participation in robotics, FPGA, PCB, or hardware-related student projects
Interest in high-speed networking systems
What You’ll Gain
Real-world experience developing engineering automation tools
Exposure to professional PCB design environments
Understanding of high-speed networking hardware platforms
Mentorship from senior layout and SI engineers
Practical application of programming in hardware development workflows
Ideal Candidate Traits
Curious about how tools work under the hood
Enjoys building utilities that improve team productivity
Detail-oriented and methodical
Comfortable debugging both code and engineering workflows

postings.description:
Über eBay
eBay Inc. (Nasdaq: EBAY) ist ein weltweit führendes Handelsunternehmen, das Millionen Käufer*innen und Verkäufer*innen in mehr als 190 Märkten auf der ganzen Welt verbindet und wirtschaftliche Möglichkeiten für einzelne Menschen, Entrepreneur*innen sowie Unternehmen und Organisationen jeder Größe schafft. eBay wurde 1995 in San José, Kalifornien, gegründet und ist einer der größten und dynamischsten Marktplätze der Welt, mit einer einzigartigen Auswahl. Im Jahr 2023 ermöglichte eBay über seine Plattform ein Handelsvolumen von mehr als 73 Milliarden US-Dollar. Weitere Informationen über das Unternehmen und sein globales Portfolio finden Sie unter www.ebayinc.com .
Werkstudent (m/w/d) Category Management – Re-Store & Refurbished
Dreilinden (bei Berlin) | Hybrides Arbeitsmodell | Ab 15. Januar | 20 Stunden pro Woche | Vorzugsweise mindestens 12 Monate | Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule oder Universität notwending | 19 760 p.a. Gehalt
Über das Team und die Rolle
Du interessierst dich für E-Commerce, nachhaltigen Konsum und innovative Geschäftsmodelle? Dann werde Teil unseres deutschen Category Management Teams für Re-Store & Refurbished bei eBay!
Unser Team treibt das Wachstum des Recommerce-Geschäfts in den Bereichen Elektronik, Haus & Garten, Medien und Sport voran.
Gemeinsam mit gewerblichen Verkäufern, Marken und strategischen Partnern arbeiten wir daran, das Angebot an gebrauchten, retournierten und wiederaufbereiteten Produkten auszubauen und neue Geschäftspotenziale zu erschließen.
Du unterstützt erfahrene Category Manager bei strategischen und operativen Projekten und übernimmst Verantwortung für eigene Aufgaben.
Deine Aufgaben
Category Management & Business Development: Unterstützung bei Wachstumsinitiativen und strategischen Projekten im Recommerce-Bereich
Inventarausbau: Identifikation neuer Geschäftspotenziale, Verkäufer und Inventarquellen zur Stärkung unseres Re-Store & Refurbished Angebots
Seller & Partner Management: Kommunikation mit gewerblichen Verkäufern und Geschäftspartnern sowie Vorbereitung strategischer Kundenmeetings
Eventmanagement: Unterstützung bei der Planung und Organisation von Branchenveranstaltungen, Industrieevents und Partnertreffen
Datenanalyse: Eigenständige Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Performanceanalysen sowie Erstellung von Präsentationen und Business Cases
Projektmanagement: Operative Betreuung ausgewählter Programme, insbesondere des Refurbished-Programms, sowie Nutzung interner eBay-Tools und Unterstützung bei Projekten zur Steigerung der Kundenzufriedenheit und zur Stärkung des Kundenvertrauens
Dein Profil
Laufendes Studium, idealerweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
Unternehmerisches Denken, analytische Fähigkeiten und Interesse an E-Commerce, Recommerce und nachhaltigen Geschäftsmodellen
Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Organisationstalent
Kommunikationsstärke, Teamgeist und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftspartnern
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel, PowerPoint und MS Office bzw. Google Workspace; SQL-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
